---
name: Operational incident
about: Record an operational failure or readiness concern
title: "[Incident] "
labels: "type: incident"
---

## Summary

Describe the impact without including secrets or sensitive personal data.

## Timeline

Include UTC timestamps and relevant commit or release identifiers.

## Affected capability

Which execution, authorization, persistence, recovery, or observability path was affected?

## Detection

How was the issue detected?

## Containment and recovery

What was stopped, rolled back, repaired, or escalated?

## Follow-up

List corrective actions, tests, alerts, and documentation updates.
